definitions.explanation: Humble form of 見る, used when the speaker views something belonging to or offered by a superior.

examples.japanese: お⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}しました。
⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}しても⟦よろしい→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I take a look at the documents? (humble)

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}しました。
お⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}しても⟦よろしい→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: May I have a look at your business card? (humble)

examples.japanese: ⟦{先日|せんじつ}→先日：03305_senjitsu⟧お⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧{企画書|きかくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}いたしました。⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦になりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I have reviewed the proposal you sent the other day. It was very helpful. (humble)

notes:
{拝見|はいけん}する is the humble (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) form of ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧. The speaker uses it to lower their own action of looking at or viewing something, showing respect to the person whose item they are viewing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}する

POLITENESS LEVELS FOR "TO SEE":
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: neutral/plain
- {拝見|はいけん}する: humble (lowers the speaker's action)
- ⟦ご{覧|らん}になる→ご覧になる：01311_goranninaru⟧: honorific (elevates the other person's action)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}する: to look at (your) photo
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拝見|はいけん}する: to look at the documents
- {拝見|はいけん}いたします: even more humble (business keigo)

USAGE:
Common in business settings, customer service, and formal interactions. Often used when receiving someone's business card, documents, or work. The object being viewed typically belongs to or was created by the person being shown respect.
